Note on the tier claim: Uptime Institute tier ratings (I-IV) are a paid, formal certification process; operator-stated tier levels in marketing material (as here) are self-described design intent, not a verified audit, and there is currently no assurance mechanism requiring operators to substantiate a stated tier, let alone to disclose the resource or carbon footprint implied by that tier level. This project treats any stated tier as unverified context, not as an input to the CV/resource-estimation pipeline.
